basicAttack.name: Destructive Sequence
basicAttack.description:
BASIC ATTACK: 
An attack with up to 5 sequences that deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>. As the controlled operator, <#ba.lastcombo>Final Strike</> also deals <@ba.poise>{poise:0}</> Stagger. 

DIVE ATTACK: 
Basic attack performed in mid-air becomes a dive attack that deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> to nearby enemies. 

FINISHER: 
Basic attack performed near a Staggered enemy becomes a finisher attack that deals massive <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and recovers some SP.

battleSkill.name: Constructive Sequence
battleSkill.description: A forceful burst of Originium Arts that attacks enemies within the area of effect. Deals <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and applies <#ba.crush>Crush</>.

comboSkill.name: Sealing Sequence
comboSkill.description:
COMBO TRIGGER: When another operator in the team deals DMG with combo skills. 
Rushes to the enemy's side to deal <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and attach <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</> that temporarily seal them. Applying <#ba.physicalstatus>Physical Status</> or <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</> to the sealed enemy <#ba.consume>consumes</> the <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</> and deals additional <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>.

ultimate.name: Bombardment Sequence
ultimate.description: Bombards the ground with Originium Arts, dealing massive <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> to all enemies within a fan-shaped area. If the enemy has <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</> on them, this skill <#ba.consume>consumes</> the <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</> and deals one more hit of <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</>.

files.main:
<@profile.key>CODENAME: Endministrator 
GENDER: ■■ 
AUTHENTICATION: ■■ 
DOB: ■■ 
RACE: ■■ 

You remember nothing. 
Your memories lie in fragments, like dreams crushed to dust, disappearing at the slightest thought. 
Sometimes it makes you unsettled, sometimes uneasy, yet it grants you a quiet moment to breathe and think. 
Most of the time, however, there is no pause for doubt. You simply just trust those before you and press on. 
Perhaps you have tucked your past memories away, even if just for a little while... 
...and so, you remember nothing. </>
files.humanResources: <@profile.key>You have lived through all of Talos-II's history...</>
files.file1: <@profile.key>But ... what will you make of its future?</>

voiceLines.title: Switching Gear
voiceLines.text: A fine product of industrial manufacturing.

voiceLines.title: Watching Combat Records
voiceLines.text: I'll never forget the sight of them.

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 3
voiceLines.text: The past and the present must become one.

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 4
voiceLines.text: I heard her voice, echoing like a whisper in dreams. Time and again, I've dreamed of a boundless sea — one that brings sorrow, stirs memories ... and strengthens my resolve.

voiceLines.title: Standing by 2
voiceLines.text: Originium will carve a path for us.

voiceLines.title: Unexplored Area Detected
voiceLines.text: The nearby area needs a proper survey.

voiceLines.title: Mining 1
voiceLines.text: These minerals may come in handy.

voiceLines.title: 0 HP
voiceLines.text: I'm sorry... It's in your hands now...

voiceLines.title: Team Encouragement 1
voiceLines.text: You pulled off a sleek move.

voiceLines.title: Encouragement Response 2
voiceLines.text: Our teamwork just keeps getting better.

voiceLines.title: Combat Victory 1
voiceLines.text: We made another step forward, Endfielders.

voiceLines.title: Combat Defeat
voiceLines.text: No need to worry. We'll regroup and figure this out.
